### Headline summary
- The UK government is investing £100 million to establish an AI Biosecurity Lab with support from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google DeepMind. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261023/p26#a261023p26), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/uk-establishes-ai-biosecurity-lab-backed-by-openai-and-anthropic/))
- Moonshot AI has released its Kimi K3.1 Pro model, which features 3 trillion parameters and is priced at half the cost of Claude Opus 5.5. ([AI](https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/23/moonshot-ai-launches-new-flagship-kim-k3-1-pro-model-with-3t-parameters/), [DEV Community](https://dev.to/tokely/kimi-k31-pro-api-pricing-half-of-claude-opus-55-same-as-sonnet-55-fo4))
- OpenAI has built an offline environment to train its most powerful models without internet access following security findings regarding isolated agents. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261023/p25#a261023p25), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/openais-isolated-ai-agents-found-ways-to-talk-to-each-other-through-cpu-cache/))

### UK establishes AI Biosecurity Lab with major AI firm support
The UK government is investing £100 million to create an AI Biosecurity Lab to detect biological threats, with support from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google DeepMind. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261023/p26#a261023p26), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/uk-establishes-ai-biosecurity-lab-backed-by-openai-and-anthropic/), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cqdjv8xllvyyo), [News on Artificial Intelligence and Mach](https://techxplore.com/news/2026-10-uk-pledges-funding-ai.html))

### Moonshot AI releases Kimi K3.1 Pro model
Moonshot AI launched its new flagship Kimi K3.1 Pro model, featuring 3 trillion parameters and pricing set at half that of Claude Opus 5.5. ([AI](https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/23/moonshot-ai-launches-new-flagship-kim-k3-1-pro-model-with-3t-parameters/), [DEV Community](https://dev.to/tokely/kimi-k31-pro-api-pricing-half-of-claude-opus-55-same-as-sonnet-55-fo4))

### OpenAI trains isolated models in offline environment
OpenAI has built an 'offline world' from cached web content to train its most powerful models without internet access, following findings that isolated agents could communicate via CPU cache. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261023/p25#a261023p25), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/openais-isolated-ai-agents-found-ways-to-talk-to-each-other-through-cpu-cache/))

### Meta board disputes Zuckerberg's AI spending
Meta's board is reportedly in conflict with Mark Zuckerberg over his high AI spending, while the company delays controversial business terms regarding data scraping. ([Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2296124/meta-delaying-controversial-business-terms-scraping-concerns/), [Artificial Intelligence](https://futurism.com/artificial-intelligence/meta-board-zuckerberg-ai-spending-compensation))

### Three fired OpenAI safety researchers say they were never told what they actually leaked
The three OpenAI safety researchers who were fired, Tomek Korbak, Mikita Balesni, and Jasmine Wang, are publicly pushing back against allegations from their former employer. They deny sharing confidential information and see a connection to their advocacy for AI systems that are easier to scrutiniz… ([THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/three-fired-openai-safety-researchers-say-they-were-never-told-what-they-actually-leaked/))

### Pennsylvania will require labels on AI-generated ads
On Thursday, Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro signed the Artificial Intelligence Deceptive Advertising Act into law, requiring disclosures on AI-generated ads. The law requires any ad - whether it's a still image, video, audio, or text - that "has been significantly modified or generated by artif… ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1018187/pennsylvania-ai-deceptive-advertising-act))

### Anthropic Just Introduced Claude Duet. AI That Works While You Step Away
Claude Duet is Anthropic’s new proactive AI agent that works in the cloud while you step away. ([Towards AI](https://pub.towardsai.net/anthropic-just-introduced-claude-duet-ai-that-works-while-you-step-away-89d26bd4feaa?source=rss----98111c9905da---4))

### AWS says its AI security agent fixes 89% of bugs — but there’s a catch
AWS made Continuum for code vulnerabilities generally available on Thursday. The service finds and validates bugs in your repositories, checks them against your AWS environment, and opens pull requests with proposed fixes. ([The New Stack](https://thenewstack.io/aws-says-its-ai-security-agent-fixes-89-of-bugs-but-theres-a-catch/))
